title: 테이블이 넓어
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad. Acoustic piano plays a steady quarter-note rhythm with occasional melodic flourishes in the upper register. A clean electric guitar provides sparse, palm-muted rhythmic accents and subtle arpeggios. Soft, legato string pads enter to fill the mid-range frequency spectrum. The male vocal is a smooth tenor, utilizing a breathy delivery in the lower register and transitioning into a clear, resonant tone in the mid-range. The arrangement maintains a minimalist, intimate texture without percussion. Key of C Major. Tempo is 72 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[acoustic piano, soft legato strings]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male tenor vocals]
문 열었어 종소리 같은 거
여기 앉아서 늘 앉던 자리야
창가 옆이야 햇살이 와 있어
너는 없어 빈 의자가 마주 봐
주문 하나 했어 아메리카노
혼자 시키니까 [clean electric guitar enters] 빨라
같은 자리인데 테이블이 넓어
